import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import cards

people = [
    {"name": " ada lovelace ", "handle": "@Ada", "bio": "Wrote the first program. " * 3, "links": ["b", "a", "b"]},
    {"name": "bob", "handle": "BOB", "bio": None},
    {"name": "cy", "handle": "cy", "bio": "  short  ", "links": []},
    {"handle": "nameless"},
    {"name": "handleless"},
    {},
]
for person in people:
    for func in (cards.build_author_card, cards.build_reviewer_card):
        try:
            print(func.__name__, func(person))
        except KeyError as exc:
            print(func.__name__, "KeyError", exc)
print("ok")
